notifications.title: How Tech Works can't make a long video: every long topic is blocked by the 'from_short' rule
notifications.detail: The rule from 12 Nov (a long video must expand one of our Shorts with 100+ views) was made for Paisa Panchayat. This channel is long-first (2 long videos a week planned) and has one Short with 25 views, so all 10 long topics Scout put in the feed today are blocked and Studio will skip this week's long videos.
notifications.fix: 1. Decide whether this channel's long videos may come straight from the feed until it has Shorts with 100+ views. 2. If yes, leave a 'general' note on the dashboard saying so; the improver adds a per-channel switch to generator/topics.py (backlog item tech-long-from-short-gate). 3. If no, nothing to do: long videos start once a Short passes 100 views.
